summary: Convergent Energy and Power and Convergent Energy + Power are aliases of one existing North American battery and solar-plus-storage platform. ECP acquired the platform through Fund IV in 2019 and continues to list it as Current; the exact legal closing day, vehicle, seller and stake are not publicly disclosed. DOE, MUFG and NY Green Bank facilities are project or portfolio financing, not new platform owners. The existing ECP period should be corrected in place without adding a duplicate owner or pending transaction.
